notes.title: STRAIN DEMO AND KICKSTARTER LAUNCH!
notes.notes:
STRAIN: The Undoing is a story-driven survival game. It is first person and single player. It is free to play for Windows.

The game follows the journey of Al, looking for his missing colleague through the apocalyptic streets of Trinity City.

This game a stand alone, complete experience. It serves as a prequel and demo for the upcoming game STRAIN.
